details: Pfizer never prints Velsipity (etrasimod) revenue on its own line in any earnings release, 10-Q or 10-K from approval (Oct 2023) through the second quarter of 2026. details: Novo Nordisk never prints Esperoct (turoctocog alfa pegol) as its own line. In every quarterly financial report read (31 reports, the Q4 2018 report through the Q2 2026 report, 6-K exhibits caq{q}{yyyy}.htm; the only table rows that name Esperoct are the footnotes 'Comprises ...'), Esperoct is one of the products inside a larger line: 'Haemophilia' / 'Rare blood disorders', whose footnote lists NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen (and Alhemo from 2024). Running text gives only a country count for Esperoct (e.g. launched in nine countries, FY2019 report) and, from FY2021, a haemophilia A products class total (which, by inference, is NovoEight plus Esperoct, not Esperoct alone); no Esperoct sales figure appears in any table or sentence. No quarterly series can be cited without interpolation or summation across products, so none is staged.
source_quote: Rare blood disorders 6 | 2,896 | (6%) | (4%) | 5,529 ... 6) Comprises NovoSeven, NovoEight, Esperoct, Refixia, NovoThirteen and Alhemo.

details: Boehringer Ingelheim is privately held, files nothing with the SEC, and reports only half-year (July) and full-year (March) results; Spiriva appears as an annual figure in its full-year releases, never as a quarter.
